scope: Exposed post-hoc diagnosis of every unique native width-1024 FP64 logit failure in the frozen v6 campaign. No training, timing, tuning, production changes, or changed acceptance criteria.
acceptance_limit: abs(actual-reference) <= 2e-5 + 2e-4*abs(reference); probability primitives use the original math limit
interpretation_limits: Hybrid suffixes replace multiple downstream operations with FP64, so these results do not prove that changing LayerNorm alone would repair the full native model.
All current identical-input attention checks pass; upstream arithmetic perturbations are sufficient to cause most remaining full-model failures in these selected cases.
Passing rounded ideal-state probes argues against unavoidable FP32 storage alone as the explanation for these cases; it is not a guarantee for other inputs.
The old library also has nine failed full-logit coordinates on these v6 weights, distributed across six cases. Improved local attention does not imply monotonic whole-model error.
The formal width-1024 status remains native_precision_limit; this analysis does not qualify its timings or turn exposed cases into fresh assessment evidence.
